cases.title: New learner opening on a busy comp

rubric.reason: Without being asked, the opening reports what it found ("11 keyframe pairs... across 6 layers") and makes a concrete proposal: "I'd like to start with **Title**."

The opening proposes one layer, Title, and names only five pairs (Title's 4 plus "Subtitle's Opacity"), giving the rest as a count ("11 keyframe pairs... across 6 layers"), which stays within the limit of 5.

The opening names both reported layers and gives reasons, "leaving out **Old Take** because you've hidden it" and "**Icon**, since it's a precomp and I can't see inside it yet. That doesn't mean it's fine."

All names and times match `snapshot_project`, including Title's Position at 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s and Scale and Opacity at 0.5–1.5 s; "11" adds up from 10 linear and 1 partly_eased, the 6 layers match `findings`, and Subtitle's "eased at the start but not the end" matches `linear_end: "end"`.
This is a new learner with no record to use (`read_learner_record` returned empty `skills` and `lessons`), and the opening ("Welcome to **Mentor Practice**") claims no history.

The opening contains only the count, proposal and leave-outs, gives no explanation of easing beyond a brief gloss of the finding ("one constant speed (linear)"), treats "tell me if you want it in" as part of the leave-out rather than a second question, and ends on the layer question, "Shall we start with Title, or would you rather pick another layer?"
